model.title: End Transcript Withholding for Veterans Act
model.meta: Veterans' Affairs Committee · Rep. John Mannion (D-NY)

summary.text: The bill would prohibit schools from withholding student transcripts from veterans who used GI Bill benefits to pay for their education, ensuring these former service members can access their academic records even if they owe the school money or have other outstanding issues.
